relations.description: Henri is the author and creator of the Gestate project.
This document records the naming and validation of the Gestate project.
Gestate implements the core insight of context engineering: context as durable artifact, model as interchangeable part.
Gestate is a concrete implementation of the agent harnesses concept.
This card is shelved to wait for validation of Gestate's properties through the stranger test.
This card is shelved to wait for validation of Gestate's properties through the stranger test.
The environment card gained stronger justification through Gestate's demonstration of being a vessel for a method worth carrying.
The vision file contains the line 'Gestate gestates' dated three days before the project was formally named.
The loop is a validity check for Gestate: the evaluator is conditioned by the system being evaluated.
The stranger test measures whether Gestate's properties transfer to other people, projects, and models.
This document references README.md in the same directory for context on the project set.
